company.shortDescription: CoinTracker is the gold standard in cryptocurrency portfolio tracking and tax compliance.
company.description:
CoinTracker is a portfolio and tax manager for cryptocurrency that enables seamless cryptocurrency portfolio tracking and tax compliance.

CoinTracker automatically syncs transactions into one unified dashboard and helps users file their crypto taxes with the click of a button.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that imports cryptocurrency activity, calculates gains, losses, income, and tax liability, and generates reports for tax filing.
productsAndServices.name: CoinTracker Crypto Tax Software

productsAndServices.description: A portfolio monitoring tool that consolidates cryptocurrency balances, transaction history, performance, net worth, gains, and losses across connected wallets and exchanges.
productsAndServices.name: CoinTracker Portfolio Tracker

productsAndServices.description: A managed cryptocurrency tax-preparation service that provides hands-off support through a dedicated account-management team for users with more complex tax situations.
productsAndServices.name: CoinTracker Full Service

productsAndServices.description: An enterprise tax-compliance solution for cryptocurrency brokers and digital-asset businesses that need to support transaction reporting and customer tax documentation.
